title: RRGEF: relative reliability-guided evidential fusion for robust multi-omics survival prediction
description: Source code accompanying the manuscript "RRGEF: relative reliability-guided evidential fusion for robust multi-omics survival prediction" (submitted to Bioinformatics). RRGEF is an evidential survival model that separates input reliability from prognostic evidence: reconstruction deviations, calibrated within training folds and compared across each patient's available modalities, determine how much each omics modality's evidence contributes to a Cox-trained risk score.
